channel.title: CWBChicago – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from CWBChicago – Bias and Credibility (cwbchicago.com)

item.title: Non-compliant offender with two warrants tried to murder Chicago cop: prosecutors - CWB Chicago
item.description: A non-compliant sex offender with two active warrants, now accused of trying to murder a Chicago Police Officer, bragged to cops who arrested him that he just got out of prison for beating other police officers, prosecutors say.

item.title: 767-page study finds some of CPD’s most violent districts are overstaffed - CWB Chicago
item.description: A long-awaited, detailed study of the Chicago Police Department's workforce allocation is now public and some of its findings will surprise the department's biggest critics. One headline: some of the city's most violence-plagued police districts were found to be among the most overstaffed in the city, while some districts considered safe and affluent were found to be understaffed.

item.title: 16-year-old on probation for robbery randomly opened fire on family's car, striking 12-year-old in the head - CWB Chicago
item.description: A family had simply pulled over to find a house where they were to meet an out-of-town guest when a 16-year-old on probation for armed robbery walked up to the driver's side, took a shooting stance and opened fire, leaving their 12-year-old son with a fractured skull, bullet fragments on his brain and temporarily paralyzed, prosecutors say.

item.title: Man robbed 5 people at gunpoint of Pokémon cards: CPD - CWB Chicago
item.description: A 23-year-old Chicago man is facing five felony robbery charges after he allegedly used Facebook Marketplace to set up meetings with sellers before pulling a gun and stealing their Pokémon cards, according to the Chicago Police Department.

item.title: Man who posed as teenager online to lure minors into sex gets 3-year sentence - CWB Chicago
item.description: A man who used a teen-focused social media app to lure underage girls into sexual encounters was sentenced to three years in prison after pleading guilty in two Cook County cases.

item.title: 55 years for murdering off-duty Chicago cop during armed robbery - CWB Chicago
item.description: A Chicago man has been sentenced to 55 years in prison for the murder of Chicago Police Officer Aréanah Preston, who was shot and killed during a robbery as she returned home from her shift in 2023, Cook County prosecutors announced Thursday.

item.title: Feds hit migrant accused of killing Loyola student with gun charge, taking ‘no chances’ on release - CWB Chicago
item.description: Federal prosecutors have filed a gun charge against a 25-year-old man accused of killing 18-year-old Loyola University freshman Sheridan Gorman in Rogers Park, describing the case as a safeguard to ensure he is not released while the state murder case proceeds.

item.title: Home invader strikes North Center woman with candle, arrest made: report - CWB Chicago
item.description: A man is in custody after he allegedly broke into a North Center woman's apartment overnight and struck her in the head with a candle.

item.title: 3 charged after trying to rob ATF agent during gun deal arranged on Instagram: feds - CWB Chicago
item.description: Three Chicago men face federal charges after they tried to rob an undercover ATF agent during a gun deal arranged on Instagram, according to a criminal complaint. The agent fired a shot during the holdup attempt, which went down in a Walmart parking lot, but no injuries were reported.

item.title: Investigation continues into death of man found beaten on Avondale street corner - CWB Chicago
item.description: Chicago police are continuing to investigate the death of Alexander Kazanowski, a 25-year-old Avondale man who died days after being found badly beaten on a street corner in the Northwest Side neighborhood last week. The Cook County Medical Examiner's Office ruled his death a homicide, caused by head trauma suffered during an assault.
